fieldData.full-article-text:
The Radix Validator Node Community Proposal program accepted applications for validator nodes up until March 15 2021. Over 350 applications were received.

Radix selected over 110 of the best proposals to participate in the Olympia Betanet. Radix are retaining control of the validators in the Radix betanet for the purposes of orderly testing. Those (and all other) potential validator node-runners are encouraged to prove themselves to the community if they wish to attract delegated stake for the Olympia Mainnet.
